<PAST H1 SPAN 1>This Agreement made and entered into this 10th day of July, 1996 ("Effective Date"), by and between SHARP CORPORATION, a Japanese corporation, having its principal place of business at 22-22, Nagaike-cho, Abeno-ku, Osaka, Japan (hereinafter called "Sharp") and Hybrid Networks, Inc., an American corporation, having its principal place of business at 10161 Bubb Road, Cupertino, California 95014-4167 (hereinafter called "Hybrid Networks").</PAST H1 SPAN 1>
<PAST H1 SPAN 2>WITNESSETH:</PAST H1 SPAN 2>
<PAST H1 SPAN 3>WHEREAS, Sharp and Hybrid Networks both have as their purpose an interest in exploring a possible business relationship and in order for the parties to explore this relationship, it may be necessary for the parties to disclose certain of their proprietary and other information to each other, which information each of the parties regards as confidential. </PAST H1 SPAN 3><PAST H1 SPAN 4>This confidential information relates to Cable Data Modem.</PAST H1 SPAN 4>
<PAST H1 SPAN 5>NOW, THEREFORE, the parties hereto agree as follows:</PAST H1 SPAN 5>
<PAST H1 SPAN 6>1. </PAST H1 SPAN 6><PAST H1 SPAN 7>(a) All of the confidential information (hereinafter "Confidential Information"), including, without limitation, all information relating to business plans, financial or technical matters, trade secrets, designs, know-how, inventions, operations and any other information received or acquired by one party ("Receiving Party") from the other ("Disclosing Party") in the course of exploring the possible business relationship shall be in written form and marked "Confidential," with the name of the Disclosing Party and the date of disclosure. </PAST H1 SPAN 7><PAST H1 SPAN 8>If the Confidential Information is initially disclosed orally, it shall be reduced to written form by the Disclosing Party (including the date of the oral disclosure and name of the Disclosing Party) and presented or mailed to the Receiving Party within fifteen (15) days of the first oral disclosure.</PAST H1 SPAN 8>
<PAST H1 SPAN 9>(b) The Confidential Information shall remain the property of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 9>
<PAST H1 SPAN 10>(c) All information disclosed which is not marked "Confidential," or not reduced to written form and marked "Confidential" if initially disclosed orally shall be considered to be non-confidential and shall not be subject to the obligations imposed by this Agreement. </PAST H1 SPAN 10><PAST H1 SPAN 11>All Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement shall be limited to the subject matter mentioned in the Recital. </PAST H1 SPAN 11><PAST H1 SPAN 12>The existence and terms of this Agreement shall be treated as Confidential Information.</PAST H1 SPAN 12>
<PAST H1 SPAN 13>2. The Receiving Party shall:</PAST H1 SPAN 13>
<PAST H1 SPAN 14>(a) hold the Confidential Information in confidence and not disclose it to third parties, except in the limited cases referred to in paragraph "6"; and</PAST H1 SPAN 14>
<PAST H1 SPAN 15>(b) not use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than exploring or examining the possibility of a business relationship between the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 15>
<PAST H1 SPAN 16>3. Either party hereto shall have the right, at any time, to terminate in writing and discussions and exchange of information in connection with the exploration of the possibilities of a business relationship between the parties without any further obligations or liabilities to the other party, other than the obligations of confidentiality hereunder, or any right or obligation relating to the Confidential Information hereunder.</PAST H1 SPAN 16>
<PAST H1 SPAN 17>4.</PAST H1 SPAN 17><PAST H1 SPAN 18>(i) The obligations of the above paragraph "2" shall not apply to any information which:</PAST H1 SPAN 18>
<PAST H1 SPAN 19>(a) is available to the public through no breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 19>
<PAST H1 SPAN 20>(b) was in the possession of the Receiving Party prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 20>
<PAST H1 SPAN 21>(c) is received independently from a third party who is free to disclose such information to the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 21>
<PAST H1 SPAN 22>(d) is subsequently independently developed by the Receiving Party; or</PAST H1 SPAN 22>
<PAST H1 SPAN 23>(e) has been or is made public by the Disclosing Party, such as by commercial use or sale or by publications or patents, or otherwise; or</PAST H1 SPAN 23>
<PAST H1 SPAN 24>(f) is approved for release by written consent of the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 24>
<PAST H1 SPAN 25>(ii) Disclosure of Confidential </PAST H1 SPAN 25><PAST H1 SPAN 26>Information shall not be precluded if such disclosure is pursuant to the requirement or request of a governmental agency or by operation of law. </PAST H1 SPAN 26><PAST H1 SPAN 27>Provided, however, the Receiving Party shall promptly give a written notice to the Disclosing party so that the Disclosing Party may seek an appropriate protective order.</PAST H1 SPAN 27>
<PAST H1 SPAN 28>5. All Confidential Information delivered to and/or in the possession of the Receiving Party shall be returned or delivered to the Disclosing Party, with all copies made thereof, in whatever form, if the Disclosing Party so requests.</PAST H1 SPAN 28>
<PAST H1 SPAN 29>6. The Receiving Party agrees that the Confidential Information shall be disclosed to only those people within its respective organizations or its agents, consultants, representatives or advisors who have a need to know the information and who are obligated under terms no less restrictive than those imposed by this Agreement on the Receiving Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 29>
<PAST H1 SPAN 30>7. Each party shall have the right to refuse to accept any information under this Agreement, and nothing herein shall obligate either party to disclose to the other party any particular information. </PAST H1 SPAN 30><PAST H1 SPAN 31>Further, each party acknowledges that no contract or agreement providing for a business relationship, of any nature, shall be deemed to exist unless and until a final definitive agreement has been executed and delivered.</PAST H1 SPAN 31>
<PAST H1 SPAN 32>8. If any official approval is required by a government authority or disclose the Confidential Information hereunder, such disclosure is subject to that approval. </PAST H1 SPAN 32><PAST H1 SPAN 33>Both parties shall comply in all respects with applicable laws, regulations and court orders, including but not limited to laws and regulations on export control, in both parties' countries and other applicable countries.</PAST H1 SPAN 33>
<PAST H1 SPAN 34>9. Disclosure of any information under this Agreement, or otherwise, shall not be construed as granting, directly or by implication, any license under or interest of any kind in any patent, patent application, copyright or other intellectual property rights.</PAST H1 SPAN 34>
<PAST H1 SPAN 35>10. The Disclosing Party represents and warrants that it has the right to disclose the information disclosed under the terms of this Agreement and that disclosure of this information does not conflict with the terms of any agreement between the Disclosing Party and a third party.</PAST H1 SPAN 35>
<PAST H1 SPAN 36>11. The parties hereto shall not be obligated to compensate each other for the disclosure and/or use pursuant to the terms of this Agreement of any information exchanged in connection with this Agreement or the discussions between the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 36>
<PAST H1 SPAN 37>12. This Agreement supersedes all prior agreements, understandings, representations and statements, whether oral or written, between the parties relating to the disclosure of the Confidential Information. </PAST H1 SPAN 37><PAST H1 SPAN 38>The terms of this Agreement may not be changed except by subsequent written agreement duly signed by an officer of each of the parties.</PAST H1 SPAN 38>
<PAST H1 SPAN 39>13. Subject to Paragraph </PAST H1 SPAN 39><PAST H1 SPAN 40>"4" hereof, the obligation of the Receiving Party provided in Paragraph "2" hereof shall continue for three (3) years from the date of each receipt of the Confidential Information, even after termination of this Agreement according to paragraph "3" hereof.</PAST H1 SPAN 40>
<PAST H1 SPAN 41>14. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Japan.</PAST H1 SPAN 41>
<PAST H1 SPAN 42>15. The Receiving Party acknowledges that remedies of damages may be inadequate to protect against breach of this Agreement and the Receiving Party agrees in advance to the granting of injunctive or other equitable relief to the Disclosing Party in addition to any other remedy which may be available to the Disclosing Party.</PAST H1 SPAN 42>
<PAST H1 SPAN 43>16. The Disclosing Party does not make any representation or warranty, except as may be specifically provided in writing, as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, or as to its utility or suitability for any purpose of the Receiving Party and the Disclosing Party expressly disclaims any right of the Receiving Party to rely thereon, or any liability to the Receiving Party resulting from the use of the Confidential Information.</PAST H1 SPAN 43>
<PAST H1 SPAN 44>IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties by their duly authorized representatives have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date first set forth above.</PAST H1 SPAN 44>
<PAST H1 SPAN 45>HYBRID NETWORKS, INC. </PAST H1 SPAN 45><PAST H1 SPAN 46>SHARP CORPORATION</PAST H1 SPAN 46>
<PAST H1 SPAN 47>By: /s/ Carl S. Ledbetter By: /s/ Akira Mitarai</PAST H1 SPAN 47>

","original_annotated_answers":{"nda-1":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[7,10]},"nda-10":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[12]},"nda-15":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[9,34]},"nda-16":{"choice":"NotMentioned","spans":[]},"nda-2":{"choice":"Contradiction","spans":[7]},"nda-20":{"choice":"Contradiction","spans":[28]},"nda-3":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[7,8,10]},"nda-4":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[13,15]},"nda-7":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[29]},"nda-8":{"choice":"Entailment","spans":[25,26,27]}},"annotations_not_claimed_successful_native_executions":true}},"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>UNIVERSITY DEFENCE RESEARCH CENTRE FOR SIGNAL PROCESSING</SPAN 0>
<SPAN 1>NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>THIS AGREEMENT is made on the day of 2011</SPAN 2>
<SPAN 3>BETWEEN:</SPAN 3>
<SPAN 4>(1) …………………………………. </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>whose registered office is at …………………………………………………….. </SPAN 5><SPAN 6>(hereinafter referred to as “The Company”) of one part; and</SPAN 6>
<SPAN 7>(2) ………………………………… </SPAN 7><SPAN 8>whose address is at………………………………………………………………… </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>(hereinafter referred to as "The University") of another part;</SPAN 9>
<SPAN 10>(3) THE SECRETARY OF STATE FOR DEFENCE acting through the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory of Porton Down, Salisbury, Wiltshire SP4 0JQ, England (hereinafter referred to as "Dstl");</SPAN 10>
<SPAN 11>(collectively the "Parties" or in the singular a "Party").</SPAN 11>
<SPAN 12>WHEREAS:</SPAN 12>
<SPAN 13>A. The University is working with Dstl as part of the University Defence Research Centre (UDRC) on signal processing and both possess valuable technical information in the field of signal processing.</SPAN 13>
<SPAN 14>B. The Company possesses valuable technical and commercial information relating to signal processing.</SPAN 14>
<SPAN 15>C. The Parties desire to discuss and mutually assess and evaluate their valuable technical and commercial information with a view to investigating whether there is a synergy between the Parties’ technical capabilities which might benefit from mutual exploitation ("the Purpose").</SPAN 15>
<SPAN 16>D. In order for the Parties to carry out said discussion, assessment and evaluation it is necessary for them to exchange valuable technical and commercial information which they each desire to protect.</SPAN 16>
<SPAN 17>NOW IT IS HEREBY AGREED BETWEEN THE PARTIES as follows:</SPAN 17>
<SPAN 18>1. As used in this Agreement the term "Proprietary Information" shall mean any information, whether in writing or other documentary form, in oral or visual or machine readable form, or in the form of algorithms, samples or models, disclosed by one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to another Party (the "Receiving Party") under this Agreement, provided that:</SPAN 18>
<SPAN 19>(a) where such information is in writing or other documentary form, it is clearly and conspicuously marked at the time of disclosure as proprietary or commercially sensitive (for example with a marking such as "Proprietary" or "Commercial-in-Confidence").; or</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>(b) where such information is disclosed in oral or visual or machine readable form, or in the form of samples or models, it is designated proprietary or commercially sensitive at the time of disclosure and is confirmed by the Disclosing Party as such in documentary form within thirty (30) days from its being disclosed, in which event all the protections and restrictions in this Agreement as to the use and disclosure of said Proprietary information shall apply retrospectively during the said period of thirty days.</SPAN 20>
<SPAN 21>Proprietary Information shall also include any information which can be obtained by examination, testing or analysis of any hardware, software or material samples provided by the Disclosing Party, notwithstanding that the requirements for marking and designation referred to above shall not have been fulfilled.</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22>2. Subject to the provisions of Clauses 4 and 7 hereof, the Receiving Party undertakes:</SPAN 22>
<SPAN 23>(a) to keep confidential and not disclose to any third party, except with the written permission of the Disclosing Party, any part, or the whole, of any Proprietary Information disclosed to it under this Agreement;</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>(b) not to copy Proprietary Information disclosed to it under this Agreement except as is reasonably necessary for the Purpose;</SPAN 24>
<SPAN 25>(c) not to use Proprietary Information disclosed to it under this Agreement other than for the Purpose, except with the prior written permission of the Disclosing Party;</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>(d) to restrict access to the Proprietary Information disclosed to it under the terms of this Agreement to those of its employees and officers who need to know the same for the Purpose.</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27>3. The protections and restrictions in this Agreement as to the use and disclosure of Proprietary Information shall not apply to any information which the Receiving Party can show by written and dated or datable material:</SPAN 27>
<SPAN 28>(a) is, at the time of disclosure hereunder, already published or otherwise publicly available; or</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>(b) is, after disclosure hereunder, published or becomes available to the public other than by breach of this Agreement; or</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>(c) is rightfully in the Receiving Party's possession with rights to use and/or disclose, prior to receipt from the Disclosing Party; or</SPAN 30>
<SPAN 31>(d) is rightfully disclosed to the Receiving Party by a third party with rights to use and/or disclose; or</SPAN 31>
<SPAN 32>(e) is independently developed by or for the Receiving Party without reference or access to Proprietary Information disclosed hereunder; or</SPAN 32>
<SPAN 33>(f) is the subject of a requirement of a court proceeding requirement on the Receiving Party for disclosure, in which event the Receiving Party shall give prompt notice thereof to the Disclosing Party to the extent permissible by law..</SPAN 33>
<SPAN 34>4. Neither Dstl nor </SPAN 34><SPAN 35>The University shall be in breach of this Agreement where it can show that any disclosure of information is made solely and to the extent necessary to comply with the Freedom of Information Act 2000 or the Environmental Information Regulations 2004. </SPAN 35><SPAN 36>Where Dstl or The University is required to make a disclosure of Proprietary Information of a Disclosing Party under the Act or the Regulations it shall, to the extent permitted by the time for compliance under the Act or the Regulations, give the Disclosing Party the opportunity to make representations concerning disclosure. </SPAN 36><SPAN 37>The Disclosing Party, however, acknowledges and accepts that its representations may not be determinative and that the decision whether to disclose the Proprietary Information at issue, in order to comply with the Act or the Regulations, is a matter in which Dstl or The University shall exercise its own discretion, subject always to the provisions of the Act or the Regulations and based upon the principle to limit said disclosure to only the requested and required information under the Act or the Regulations. </SPAN 37><SPAN 38>Dstl or The University shall in any event provide prior notification to the Disclosing Party of any decision to disclose any of its Proprietary Information.</SPAN 38>
<SPAN 39>5. Nothing contained in this Agreement shall be construed as:</SPAN 39>
<SPAN 40>(a) conferring upon the Receiving Party any right of use in or title to Proprietary Information received by it from the Disclosing Party, other than as expressly provided herein or as conferred in writing upon the Receiving Party by the Disclosing Party subsequent to the date of this Agreement; or</SPAN 40>
<SPAN 41>(b) constituting a warranty as to the accuracy of the Proprietary Information or the suitability thereof for any purpose whatsoever; or</SPAN 41>
<SPAN 42>(c) diminishing the rights any Party has under Statute; or</SPAN 42>
<SPAN 43>(d) implying that a further contractual arrangement will be concluded between the Parties; or</SPAN 43>
<SPAN 44>(e) overriding or prejudicing any Government security classification or export control regulation applicable to any part of the Proprietary Information; or</SPAN 44>
<SPAN 45>(f) requiring any Party to disclose to any other any particular Proprietary Information.</SPAN 45>
<SPAN 46>6. All Proprietary Information disclosed hereunder, and any copies thereof made by a Receiving Party, shall be and remain the Disclosing Party's property and shall be delivered up promptly by the Receiving Party to the Disclosing Party on receipt of the Disclosing Party's written request therefor.</SPAN 46>
<SPAN 47>7. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of two (2) years following the date first above written after which it will terminate unless renewed by mutual consent in writing or to the extent that it is superseded by another agreement or contract between the Parties. </SPAN 47><SPAN 48>The obligations and restrictions relating to the disclosure and use of Proprietary Information shall however survive the termination of this Agreement for a period of seven (7) years.</SPAN 48>
<SPAN 49>8. This Agreement constitutes the entire existing Agreement between the Parties concerning the exchange of Proprietary Information for the Purpose. </SPAN 49><SPAN 50>The Agreement shall not be amended except by written agreement signed by authorised representatives of all Parties.</SPAN 50>
<SPAN 51>9. No Party shall, without the express consent in writing of the other Parties, assign or in any manner transfer its interests in, or obligations under, this Agreement or any part thereof.</SPAN 51>
<SPAN 52>10. A person who is not a party to this Agreement shall have no right under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term of this Agreement. </SPAN 52><SPAN 53>This clause does not affect any right or remedy of any person which exists or is available otherwise than pursuant to that Act.</SPAN 53>
<SPAN 54>11. This Agreement shall be construed and governed in accordance with the laws of England and the Parties hereby submit to the jurisdiction of the English courts.</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>12. The Parties shall attempt to solve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement by means of alternative dispute resolution such as but without limitation mediation or mini-trial.</SPAN 55>
<SPAN 56>Upon the occurrence of the dispute, the Parties shall define the type and the rules for the implementation of such alternative resolution.</SPAN 56>
<SPAN 57>The Parties expressly agree that after a period of two (2) months after the occurrence of the dispute and provided that the dispute remains unsolved, it shall be finally settled under the rules of Arbitration of the London Court of International Arbitration by one or more arbitrators appointed in accordance with the said rules. </SPAN 57><SPAN 58>The place of arbitration shall be London (UK). </SPAN 58><SPAN 59>The language of arbitration shall be the English Language.</SPAN 59>
<SPAN 60>The Parties hereby agree to exclude the right of appeal to the High Court under section 69 of the Arbitration Act 1996 and the right for an application to be made to the High Court under the corresponding section of the Act.</SPAN 60>
<SPAN 61>Each Party recognises and acknowledges that in the event of any actual or threatened breach of this Agreement it shall have the right to apply for injunctive relief or other appropriate orders before any competent court to restrain the other as a remedy for any such breach.</SPAN 61>
<SPAN 62>Signed for and on behalf of [THE COMPANY]</SPAN 62>
<SPAN 63>By: .............................................. </SPAN 63><SPAN 64>Date: ...................................………..</SPAN 64>
<SPAN 65>Name: Title:</SPAN 65>
<SPAN 66>Signed for and on behalf of [THE UNIVERSITY]</SPAN 66>
<SPAN 67>By: .............................................. </SPAN 67><SPAN 68>Date: ...................................………..</SPAN 68>

<SPAN 70>Signed on behalf of THE SECRETARY OF STATE FOR DEFENCE</SPAN 70>
<SPAN 71>By: ............................................. </SPAN 71><SPAN 72>Date: ...............................................</SPAN 72>
